parsed.corrected_rationale: The answer quotes a passage from the paper concerning the definition of individual fairness for training algorithms, specifically the statement that a difference in privacy risks can be large if users' data are dissimilar. However, the reviewer's actual comment is only 'I am not sure how this relates to the former sentence. Doesn't really make sense,' which does not explicitly identify the location of this passage in the paper (e.g., no section, page, or figure is mentioned), so the authors cannot confidently determine which part is being addressed. Moreover, the comment does not explain what is wrong or what needs to be fixed; it merely expresses confusion about how the quoted sentence relates to the preceding one. Thus the comment neither pinpoints a specific part of the paper nor specifies what needs to be addressed in that part.
